{
  "analysis": "pypdf API is different. The page has embedded images (ImageB, ImageC). I'll use pypdf's images extraction feature.",

  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "cat > /tmp/extract_img.py << 'EOF'
import pypdf
r = pypdf.PdfReader('/app/Harmony.pdf')
page = r.pages[0]
imgs = page.images
print('num images:', len(imgs))
for i, img in enumerate(imgs):
    print('image', i, 'name:', img.name, 'size:', img.image.size if hasattr(img,'image') else '?')
    out = '/tmp/img_%d.png' % i
    with open(out,'wb') as f:
        f.write(img.data)
    print('saved', out, 'bytes:', len(img.data))
EOF
python3 /tmp/extract_img.py 2>&1
